count_rule: Origin date belongs to its role/year; its h-step target must mature within the same role/year. History may precede the role but never the dataset start. No calendar filling; no price-dependent eligibility. Overlapping origins are not independent samples.

formal_observation_blocks.rule: test_start = first quote index of evaluation year; cal_end = test_start-h-1; cal_start = cal_end-251; val_end = cal_start-h-1; val_start = val_end-125; train_end = val_start-h-1; train_start=39. End indices are inclusive. Every earlier role's last target matures strictly before the next role's first origin. Test origin and endpoint belong to the same evaluation year.

exclusion_reasons: Predefined before new model fitting: Shanghai has 47 author quotes in 2021 and only 27 L20/H20 same-year mature origins; exclude the entire 2021 Shanghai evaluation, retaining source rows and all audit counts.
